findings.description: Matěj Janovský and his wife Kateřina Votýpková had a son František, born 4 October 1874 at Malšice no. 80 and baptised 5 October 1874 at Malšice, Tábor, Bohemia. The baptism index gives the mother only as Kateřina; the register entry names the father Matěj Janovský, son of Jan Janovský and Anna Háková (Haklová), and the mother Kateřina, daughter of Josef Votýpka and Anna Peštová, the same parents as on the couple's 27 October 1866 Malšice marriage.

findings.description: Matěj Janovský and a wife Kateřina had a daughter Anna, born 17 May 1869 and baptised 18 May 1869 at Malšice, Tábor, Bohemia. Index-only: the entry names the mother only as Kateřina, and its page image was not read, so the link to this Matěj rests on him being the only Matěj Janovský found marrying a Kateřina at Malšice in the period.
